courses.title: Enterprise Cybersecurity Foundations & Zero-Trust Architecture
courses.shortDescription: Master identity-first security, cryptographic transport, secrets hygiene, and incident containment across corporate infrastructure.
courses.fullDescription: Designed for engineering, operations, and corporate staff, this flagship program establishes rigorous cybersecurity practices across cloud and on-premise environments. Learners implement least-privilege access control, audit identity boundaries, defend against credential phishing, and execute structured incident response playbooks.
objectives: Enforce Zero-Trust authentication and hardware-backed MFA across enterprise portals
Eliminate hardcoded secrets and configure server-side credential isolation
Design PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) policies to prevent horizontal privilege escalation
Execute rapid containment and forensic logging during security incidents
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with web applications and corporate identity accounts

lessons.title: 1.1 Principles of Least Privilege & Identity Boundaries
lessons.content:
In a Zero-Trust architecture, network locality never implies trust. Every request—whether originating from headquarters or a remote endpoint—must be authenticated, authorized against explicit role policies, and continuously validated.

Key Takeaways:
1. Separate authentication identity from authorization roles in dedicated server-validated tables.
2. Block public self-registration on internal enterprise portals; provision accounts exclusively through verified administrative workflows.
3. Enforce short-lived session tokens with strict HTTP-only cookie attributes.

lessons.title: 1.2 Server-Side Secret Isolation & API Gateways
lessons.content:
Privileged credentials—such as database service-role keys, signing secrets, and third-party API tokens—must remain strictly on the server.

Architectural Rules:
• Never prefix privileged keys with NEXT_PUBLIC_ or bundle them into client JavaScript.
• Validate every mutation payload with strict schema validation (Zod) before touching persistence layers.
• Record administrative state changes in an append-only audit log with actor ID, timestamp, and target entity.

sections.title: Module 2: Database Security & Final Certification Exam

lessons.title: 2.1 Row-Level Security (RLS) & Tenant Isolation
lessons.content:
Frontend route guards improve user experience, but true security lives at the API and database layer. PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) guarantees that even if a query is constructed broadly, rows outside the authenticated user’s scope remain invisible.

Policy Verification Pattern:
• Anonymous role: 0 access to learner profiles, enrollments, or certificates.
• Learner role: SELECT/UPDATE restricted to user_id = auth.uid().
• Manager role: SELECT restricted to organization_id matching the manager’s assigned scope.
• Super Admin: Verified via security-definer role lookup.

lessons.title: 2.2 Final Certification Assessment
lessons.content: Complete the graded certification examination with a score of 80% or higher to earn your official Learning Hub Enterprise Cybersecurity Certificate.

courses.title: AML, KYC & Financial Regulatory Compliance 2026
courses.shortDescription: Mandatory regulatory training covering Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC) verification, and suspicious transaction escalation.
courses.fullDescription: This mandatory compliance program equips employees in financial operations, engineering, and customer-facing roles with actionable procedures to detect financial crime, perform enhanced due diligence (EDD), protect customer PII, and comply with international regulatory frameworks.
objectives: Identify red-flag indicators of money laundering and structuring across payment channels
Perform Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) verification workflows
Escalate Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) through confidential compliance channels without tipping off
prerequisites: Mandatory for all active corporate employees

lessons.title: 1.1 Three Stages of Money Laundering & Red Flags
lessons.content: Understand Placement, Layering, and Integration across digital payment ecosystems. Learn how structuring, rapid cross-border velocity, and dormant account reactivation signal elevated risk.

lessons.title: 1.2 Customer Due Diligence (CDD) & SAR Escalation Protocol
lessons.content: When anomalous activity is detected, employees must document objective transaction evidence and submit an internal report to the Compliance Officer within 24 hours. Never disclose to the customer that an investigation or SAR is underway.

lessons.title: 1.3 Mandatory AML/KYC Compliance Examination
lessons.content: Pass the regulatory compliance examination (minimum 80%) to satisfy annual corporate compliance requirements.

courses.title: Production PostgreSQL & Distributed Data Architecture
courses.shortDescription: Normalized schema design, transactional integrity, composite indexing, connection pooling, and query optimization at scale.
courses.fullDescription: An advanced engineering course focused on operating mission-critical PostgreSQL databases. Covers ACID isolation levels, deadlock prevention, B-Tree and GIN indexing strategies, Drizzle/SQL migration governance, and zero-downtime schema evolution.
objectives: Design normalized 3NF relational schemas with strict foreign keys and uniqueness constraints
Optimize slow queries using EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) and covering indexes
Configure resilient connection pools and safe transactional boundaries
prerequisites: Working knowledge of SQL and backend application development

lessons.title: 1.1 Normalized Schema Design & Referential Integrity
lessons.content: Every production entity requires deterministic primary keys, explicit foreign key cascade rules, and check constraints that prevent invalid domain states from ever reaching disk.

lessons.title: 1.2 Connection Pooling & Multi-Step Transactions
lessons.content: Lazy on-demand connection pools prevent connection exhaustion in serverless compute environments. Multi-step mutations (such as recording an assessment attempt and issuing a certificate) must execute atomically.

courses.title: Engineering Leadership & High-Reliability Teams
courses.shortDescription: Build high-trust engineering organizations through structured Competency Matrices, Training Needs Analysis (TNA), and operational excellence.
courses.fullDescription: Equip engineering managers and department heads with frameworks for evaluating team competencies, diagnosing skill gaps before they impact delivery, and structuring measurable development plans.
objectives: Conduct objective Training Needs Analysis (TNA) across technical and operational roles
Distinguish course completion metrics from on-the-job competency progression
Run blameless post-mortems and structured quarterly skill reviews
prerequisites: Team Lead, Manager, or Senior IC role

lessons.title: 1.1 Designing a 5-Level Job Competency Scale
lessons.content: A transparent 1-to-5 competency scale separates foundational awareness (Level 1) from independent execution (Level 3) and organizational architectural leadership (Level 5).

courses.title: Cloud Incident Response & Forensics Playbook
courses.shortDescription: Triage, isolate, and investigate cloud security breaches using immutable telemetry and automated containment runbooks.
courses.fullDescription: Submitted by Dr. Sophea Vann for administrative review. Covers Kubernetes pod isolation, IAM key rotation under fire, memory forensics, and executive incident reporting.
objectives: Contain compromised cloud workloads within 15 minutes of alert triage
Preserve chain-of-custody forensic snapshots for regulatory audit

lessons.title: 1.1 Automated IAM Revocation & Network Quarantine
lessons.content: Walkthrough of isolating compromised cloud credentials without destroying volatile forensic state.

questions.prompt: According to Learning Hub security architecture, how must learner accounts be provisioned?

options.text: Through a public self-registration sign-up form
Exclusively by authorized Super Administrators via a server-validated provisioning workflow
By passing a role parameter from the browser query string

questions.explanation: Public learner self-registration is strictly disabled; only authorized administrators can create accounts on the server.

questions.prompt: Select ALL mandatory security controls required for protecting privileged credentials and API routes:

options.text: Keep service-role keys exclusively in server-side environment variables
Enforce PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) alongside server-side role verification
Prefix service-role keys with NEXT_PUBLIC_ for easier client debugging
Record administrative user and role mutations in an immutable audit log

questions.explanation: Service-role keys must never be exposed via NEXT_PUBLIC_; server-side validation, RLS, and audit logging are mandatory.

questions.prompt: True or False: Hiding an administration link in the frontend navigation menu is sufficient to secure an administrative route.
questions.explanation: Security by obscurity is never sufficient; every route and API endpoint must enforce server-side RBAC and database RLS.

questions.prompt: What PostgreSQL feature restricts which rows a user can read or modify based on their authenticated identity and role? (Enter the 3-letter acronym)
questions.explanation: Row-Level Security (RLS) enforces fine-grained row access policies directly inside PostgreSQL.

questions.prompt: When an employee identifies a suspicious transaction pattern, what is the required escalation action?

options.text: Contact the customer immediately and ask if they are laundering funds
Escalate an internal Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) to the Compliance Officer within 24 hours without tipping off the customer
Post the transaction details in a public chat channel

questions.explanation: Employees must escalate suspicious activity confidentially to Compliance within 24 hours and never tip off the subject.

questions.prompt: True or False: Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) is required for Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) and high-risk jurisdictions.
questions.explanation: High-risk customers and PEPs require Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) under AML/KYC regulations.

assessments.title: PostgreSQL Architecture & Performance Assessment
assessments.description: Technical examination on relational normalization, indexing, and connection pool management.

questions.prompt: Why should multi-step operations (such as grading an exam and issuing a certificate) run inside a database transaction?

options.text: To guarantee atomicity so all related records succeed or roll back together
To expose raw SQL errors to the browser

questions.explanation: Database transactions guarantee ACID atomicity so partial state corruption cannot occur.
